## Abstract
## Introduction

## Dataset
The dataset used in this study is the 2006 Saratoga Housing Data, which contains 1,734 observations and 17 variables ranging over various housing characteristics.The data were originally collected to answer the case study question: "How much is a fireplace worth?"

The dependent variable is Price of each house. The data contain no missing values and include the dependent variable, Price, alongside predictor variables such as Lot Size, Living Area, Land Value, Age, Waterfront, New.Construct, Central.Air, Fuel.Type, and others.

## Analysis
```{r}
# Clean
data_cleaned <- data %>%
  filter(Lot.Size > 0) %>%
  filter(!(Age == 0 & New.Construct == 0))

data_cleaned <- data_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    Log.Price = log(Price),
    Log.Lot.Size = log(Lot.Size),
    Log.Age = ifelse(Age != 0, log(Age), 0),
    Log.Land.Value = log(Land.Value)
  ) %>%
  select(-Price, -Lot.Size, -Age, -Land.Value, -Test)
```

A multiple linear regression model was used to review how property characteristics influence Log(Price). Prior to building our model, basic data cleaning was done to remove invalid and inconsistent entries such as Lot.Size = 0 or Age = 0 with New.Construct = 0. All categorical variables are also encoded into factors. Finally, log transformations were applied to skewed variables (Price, Lot.Size, Age, Land.Value) to stabilize variance and improve normality. 

As part of the initial data exploration, variables were grouped into unchangeable (e.g., Lot.Size, Waterfront, Age, Land.Value, Pct.College) and changeable factors (e.g., Living.Area, Bathrooms, Bedrooms, Central.Air, Fireplaces, New.Construct, Fuel.Type). We performed stepwise selection within each group to assess significance, and found that 38% of the housing price variation is explained by unchangeable factors $(R^2 = 0.38)$ while 55% are of changeable factors $(R^2 = 0.55)$.

```{r}
# --- STEPWISE SELECTION ON FULL MODEL ---

M0_null <- lm(Log.Price ~ 1, data = data_cleaned)
M1_full <- lm(Log.Price ~ ., data = data_cleaned)

n <- nrow(data_cleaned)
```

```{r stepwise-selection}
step.bwd.aic = step(M1_full, direction = "backward", trace = 0)
step.fwd.aic = step(M0_null, scope = list(upper = M1_full, lower = M0_null), direction = "forward", trace = 0)
step.both.aic = step(M0_null, scope = list(upper = M1_full, lower = M0_null), direction = "both", trace = 0)
step.bwd.bic = step(M1_full, k = log(n), direction = "backward", trace = 0)
step.fwd.bic = step(M0_null, k = log(n), scope = list(upper = M1_full, lower = M0_null), direction = "forward", trace = 0)
step.both.bic = step(M0_null, k = log(n), scope = list(upper = M1_full, lower = M0_null), direction = "both", trace = 0)
```

```{r stepwise-selection-p}

# Stepwise selection based on p-value threshold
stepwise_p <- function(min_model, full_model, direction = c("both", "backward", "forward"), alpha_enter = 0.05, alpha_remove = 0.05) {
  if (direction == "backward") {
    current_model <- full_model
  } else {
    current_model <- min_model
  }
  repeat {
    # Forward selection: check which variable to add
    if (direction != "backward") {
      add_candidates <- add1(current_model, scope = formula(full_model), test = "F")
      add_candidates <- add_candidates[-1, ]  # remove (none)
      
      p_add <- add_candidates$`Pr(>F)`
      if(any(p_add < alpha_enter)) {
        # Add the most significant variable
        best_var <- rownames(add_candidates)[which.min(p_add)]
        current_model <- update(current_model, paste(". ~ . +", best_var))
        next
      }
    }
    
    # Backward elimination: check which variable to remove
    if (direction != "forward") {
      if(length(coef(current_model)) > 1) {
        drop_candidates <- drop1(current_model, test = "F")
        drop_candidates <- drop_candidates[-1, ]  # remove intercept
        p_drop <- drop_candidates$`Pr(>F)`
        if(any(p_drop > alpha_remove)) {
          worst_var <- rownames(drop_candidates)[which.max(p_drop)]
          current_model <- update(current_model, paste(". ~ . -", worst_var))
          next
        }
      }
    }
    
    break
  }
  return(current_model)
}

# Run stepwise selection
step.bwd.p = stepwise_p(M0_null, M1_full, direction = "backward")
step.fwd.p <- stepwise_p(M0_null, M1_full, direction = "forward")
step.both.p <- stepwise_p(M0_null, M1_full, direction = "both")
```

```{r exhaustive-search-1}
# EXHAUSTIVE SEARCH 1
# Using lmSubsets::lmSelect() function
lmSubsets.aic = lmSelect(Log.Price ~ ., data = data_cleaned, penalty = "AIC")
fit.lmSubsets.aic =lm(formula(lmSubsets.aic), data = data_cleaned)

lmSubsets.bic = lmSelect(Log.Price ~ ., data = data_cleaned, penalty = "BIC")
fit.lmSubsets.bic <- lm(formula(lmSubsets.bic), data = data_cleaned)
```

```{r exhaustive-search-2, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# EXHAUSTIVE SEARCH 2
# Using leaps::regsubsets() function

library(leaps)

invisible(capture.output(
  exhaustive <- regsubsets(Log.Price ~ ., data = data_cleaned, 
                           nbest = 1, nvmax = 15, method = "exhaustive")
))
summary_exh <- summary(exhaustive)

# Function to clean dummy variable names from regsubsets
clean_dummy_names <- function(dummy_vars, data) {
  cleaned <- sapply(dummy_vars, function(varname) {
    # Remove trailing numbers (e.g., "Waterfront1" -> "Waterfront")
    base <- gsub("\\d+$", "", varname)
    
    # Check if it matches a factor level pattern like "Fuel.TypeGas" -> "Fuel.Type"
    matched <- sapply(names(data), function(col) {
      if (is.factor(data[[col]]) || is.character(data[[col]])) {
        startsWith(varname, col)
      } else FALSE
    })
    
    if (any(matched)) {
      names(data)[matched][1]  # return the first matching column
    } else {
      base  # fallback: return stripped number version
    }
  })
  
  unique(cleaned)
}
```

```{r exhaustive-search-2.5}
# Compute AIC and BIC for each subset
aic_values <- n * log(summary_exh$rss / n) + 2 * (1 + summary_exh$which %>% rowSums())
bic_values <- n * log(summary_exh$rss / n) + log(n) * (1 + rowSums(summary_exh$which))

# Select model with the best AIC
i_best_aic <- which.min(aic_values)
best_vars_aic <- setdiff(names(which(summary_exh$which[i_best_aic, ]))[summary_exh$which[i_best_aic, ]], "(Intercept)")
best_vars_aic <- best_vars_aic[!is.na(best_vars_aic)]
best_vars_aic_clean <- clean_dummy_names(best_vars_aic, data_cleaned)
formula_best_aic <- as.formula(paste("Log.Price ~", paste(best_vars_aic_clean, collapse = " + ")))
leaps.aic <- lm(formula_best_aic, data = data_cleaned)

# Select model with the best BIC
i_best_bic <- which.min(bic_values)
best_vars_bic <- setdiff(names(which(summary_exh$which[i_best_bic, ]))[summary_exh$which[i_best_bic, ]], "(Intercept)")
best_vars_bic <- best_vars_bic[!is.na(best_vars_bic)]
best_vars_bic_clean <- clean_dummy_names(best_vars_bic, data_cleaned)
formula_best_bic <- as.formula(paste("Log.Price ~", paste(best_vars_bic_clean, collapse = " + ")))
leaps.bic <- lm(formula_best_bic, data = data_cleaned)
```

```{r exhaustive-search-3, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# EXHAUSTIVE SEARCH 3
# Using MuMIn::dredge() function
library(MuMIn)
global_model <- lm(Log.Price ~ ., data = data_cleaned, na.action = na.pass)
all_subsets <- dredge(global_model, rank = "AIC", 
                      extra = c("BIC", "R^2", "adjR^2"))
```

```{r exhaustive-search-3.5}
all_subsets <- all_subsets[order(all_subsets$AIC), ]
MuMIn.aic <- get.models(all_subsets, 1)[[1]]
all_subsets <- all_subsets[order(all_subsets$BIC), ]
MuMIn.bic <- get.models(all_subsets, 1)[[1]]

all_subsets$num_vars <- 15 - rowSums(is.na(all_subsets))
low_BIC_subsets <- subset(all_subsets, BIC <= BIC(MuMIn.bic)+2)
low_BIC_subsets <- low_BIC_subsets[order(low_BIC_subsets$num_vars), ]
MuMIn.bic2 <- get.models(low_BIC_subsets, 1)[[1]]
```

```{r exhaustive-search-summary, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(modelsummary)
msummary(list(`lmSubsets Exhaustive AIC` = fit.lmSubsets.aic,
              `leaps Exhaustive AIC` = leaps.aic,
              `MuMIn Exhaustive AIC` = MuMIn.aic,
              `lmSubsets Exhaustive BIC` = fit.lmSubsets.bic,
              `leaps Exhaustive BIC` = leaps.bic,
              `MuMIn Exhaustive BIC` = MuMIn.bic),
         coef_omit = c(-1),
         title = "Exhaustive search summary",
         fmt = fmt_statistic(rmse = 3))
```

```{r changeable-unchangeable, include = FALSE}
# --- Define groups ---
unchangeable_vars <- c("Log.Lot.Size", "Waterfront", "Log.Age", "Log.Land.Value", "Pct.College")
changeable_vars   <- c("Living.Area", "Bathrooms", "Bedrooms", "Rooms",
                       "Central.Air", "New.Construct", "Heat.Type",
                       "Fuel.Type", "Fireplaces", "Sewer.Type")
data_U <- data_cleaned[, c("Log.Price", unchangeable_vars)]
data_C <- data_cleaned[, c("Log.Price", changeable_vars)]

#--- UNCHANGEABLE VARIABLES ---
m0_U <- lm(Log.Price ~ 1, data = data_U)
m1_U <- lm(Log.Price ~ ., data = data_U)
# Forward selection
step_fwd_U <- step(m0_U, scope = list(lower = m0_U, upper = m1_U),
                   direction = "forward", trace = FALSE)
# Backward selection
step_back_U <- step(m1_U, direction = "backward", trace = FALSE)
# Stepwise (both)
step_both_U <- step(m0_U, scope = list(lower = m0_U, upper = m1_U),
                    direction = "both", trace = FALSE)
# Compare the models
msummary(list(`Step fwd` = step_fwd_U,
              `Step bwd` = step_back_U,
              `Step both` = step_both_U),
         title = "Unchangeable models from stepwise selection (AIC)")
# The 3 models given by stepwise selection are the same
unchangeable.lm <- step_both_U

# --- CHANGEABLE VARIABLES ---
m0_C <- lm(Log.Price ~ 1, data = data_C)
m1_C <- lm(Log.Price ~ ., data = data_C)
# Forward selection
step_fwd_C <- step(m0_C, scope = list(lower = m0_C, upper = m1_C),
                   direction = "forward", trace = FALSE)
# Backward selection
step_back_C <- step(m1_C, direction = "backward", trace = FALSE)
# Stepwise (both)
step_both_C <- step(m0_C, scope = list(lower = m0_C, upper = m1_C),
                    direction = "both", trace = FALSE)
# Compare the models
msummary(list(`Step fwd` = step_fwd_C,
              `Step bwd` = step_back_C,
              `Step both` = step_both_C),
         title = "Changeable models from stepwise selection (AIC)")
# The 3 models given by stepwise selection are the same
changeable.lm <- step_both_C
```
